authority.status: proposed; uncommitted in the primary worktree at board creation

execution_rules: Use the shared feature-lane worktree only. The primary repository is dirty and read-only for this board.
Do not stage, commit, push, merge, rebase, alter provider credentials, add a production schedule, or enable a live source.
Do not copy World Monitor code or install its dependency tree. Keep the implementation clean-room and BSS-native.
Run the task's stated verification. For RED cards, a narrowly scoped expected failure is the completion evidence; do not implement the production behavior in a RED-only card.
Before completion, run git diff --check. Report changed paths, commands, exact result, and any unresolved blocker in the Kanban handoff.

Read the authority package at its absolute root and verify the relevant artifact SHA-256 before design-sensitive work. The task body is the board snapshot; do not rewrite authority to suit an implementation shortcut.

tasks.title: T000: Node 24 execution-runtime preflight
tasks.source_task: Verify a Node 24 runtime in the execution workspace against .nvmrc and vm/cybermap-api/package.json; block if absent without installing or replacing a runtime.
tasks.acceptance: The worker records an executable Node 24 path/version that satisfies >=24.0.0 <25. Any other result is a specific environment block; this card changes no runtime, source, credentials, or workspace files.

tasks.title: T001: RED global viewport contract
tasks.source_task: Add RED GlobalViewport request/response validation and forbidden raw-field cases for TST-001.
tasks.acceptance: The new tests cover valid bounds/zoom/layers, malformed and antimeridian-wrapped bounds, unsupported zoom, unknown layer, cell budget, and rejection of raw observation fields. The failure must be caused by the absent global contract, not a test syntax or fixture error.

tasks.title: T002: RED migration guardrails
tasks.source_task: Add RED disposable-PostGIS migration cases in global-viewport-migration.test.mjs for source policy, H3 resolution, fetch-run immutability, and source-class constraints for TST-008.
verification: document the injected disposable-PostGIS prerequisite for the later executed proof
tasks.acceptance: The test design defines invalid writes for non-Green preload, forbidden H3 resolutions, update/delete of source-fetch receipts, and excluded source classes. It uses CYBERMAP_TEST_DATABASE_URL for an approved ephemeral PostGIS instance; a missing variable name-skips and never produces a false pass.

tasks.title: T003: migration 0004 global cells and sources
tasks.source_task: Add migration 0004; extend source metadata, protect append-only source_fetch_runs, and permit H3 resolution 5.
tasks.acceptance: Migration preserves existing local viewport behavior, admits H3 5/7/9/11 only, keeps catalog policy server-enforced, and rejects UPDATE/DELETE of source_fetch_runs. No provider is enabled by the migration.

tasks.title: T004: GlobalViewportRequestV1 contract
tasks.source_task: Implement strict request parsing and aggregate response shaping in global-viewport-contract.mjs for TST-001.
tasks.acceptance: Valid GlobalViewportRequestV1 data has a canonical bounded form. Responses expose aggregate cells and source status only; raw identifiers, device coordinates, packet metadata, and provider credentials cannot enter the response.

tasks.title: T005: RED aggregate PostGIS viewport tests
tasks.source_task: Add RED source-class and aggregate-only query tests for TST-002.
tasks.acceptance: Seeded sources span all classes. The test asserts that only catalog-approved Green aggregate cells are returned, a result limit exists, and raw observation fields never appear.

tasks.title: T006: bounded aggregate queryGlobalViewport
tasks.source_task: Add bounded aggregate queryGlobalViewport to Postgres and equivalent behavior to memory-store; preserve queryViewport.
tasks.acceptance: The query applies bounds, zoom-derived permitted H3 resolution, Green/source-catalog policy, and a hard feature limit. Existing point/radius queryViewport behavior remains unchanged.

tasks.title: T007: RED VM global viewport route tests
tasks.source_task: Add RED VM authentication/body/bounds/no-network tests for TST-003.
tasks.acceptance: The route test covers missing/invalid/valid backend read credentials, malformed body, fixed error mapping, no-store semantics, and proves a request cannot trigger an external provider fetch.

tasks.title: T008: POST VM global viewport route
tasks.source_task: Add POST /api/v1/cybermap/global-viewport and fixed error mapping in server.mjs for TST-003.
tasks.acceptance: The token-gated POST route accepts only GlobalViewportRequestV1, calls the materialized store only, returns controlled errors/no-store headers, and never performs source I/O.

tasks.title: T009: RED SWA global viewport proxy tests
tasks.source_task: Add RED SWA proxy authentication/header/no-store/error tests for TST-006.
tasks.acceptance: Tests require an authenticated operator guard, a fixed backend-read credential only, no-store output, and controlled upstream error mapping.

tasks.title: T010: token-gated SWA global viewport proxy
tasks.source_task: Add the operator-authenticated Function api/cybermap-global-viewport for TST-006.
tasks.acceptance: The Function validates the operator session, forwards only the fixed server-side backend read credential, preserves POST body boundaries, and does not expose backend URLs or credentials to the operator browser.

tasks.title: T011: RED Greenfeed materializer tests
tasks.source_task: Add RED H3 parent/cell-sanitization/idempotent materialization tests for TST-004.
tasks.acceptance: Fixture-only tests demand deterministic external keys, H3 5/7/9/11 parent aggregation, idempotence, and strict removal of raw evidence fields.

tasks.title: T012: Greenfeed H3 materializer
tasks.source_task: Implement the materializer from append-only greenfeed_snapshot observations for TST-004.
tasks.acceptance: The materializer produces only bounded aggregate payloads, is idempotent, has no network transport, and does not seed sample data when source data is empty.

tasks.title: T013: RED Greenfeed worker safety tests
tasks.source_task: Add RED worker outcomes, backoff, terms-unreviewed, fixture-only, and credential-redaction tests for TST-005.
tasks.acceptance: Tests cover success, empty, rate-limited, invalid, timeout, and terms-unreviewed outcomes. They prohibit data seeding/enabling on failure and credential or error-body leakage.

tasks.title: T014: bounded Greenfeed worker and fetch receipts
tasks.source_task: Implement the bounded source worker and source_fetch_runs recorder for TST-005.
tasks.acceptance: The worker takes injected transport/config, records append-only bounded state, obeys disabled/terms-unreviewed policy, applies backoff, and never makes source reads on an operator map request.

tasks.title: T015: disabled reviewed Greenfeed adapters
tasks.source_task: Add fixture-only adapters and normalization tests for USGS, GDACS, and NASA EONET. Do not configure credentials or schedules.
tasks.acceptance: Each adapter uses only owned fixtures during test, exposes deterministic normalization, remains disabled by default, has explicit attribution/caveat metadata, and contains no credentials or runtime fallback.

tasks.title: T016: RED Godeye Field/Global shell tests
tasks.source_task: Add RED field/global mode, no-geolocation-global, health-ledger, stale/error/empty, and no-provider-URL tests for TST-007.
verification: node --test tests/godeye-global-shell.test.mjs (expected RED: absent Global mode)
tasks.acceptance: Tests preserve the current 100 m Field flow and demand an explicit Global mode that avoids geolocation and provider URLs while presenting transparent source-health states.

tasks.title: T017: Godeye Global dispatch module
tasks.source_task: Add godeye-global.mjs and dispatch between retained Field and Global modes for TST-007.
tasks.acceptance: The operator explicitly selects Global. Field remains GPS/local and unchanged. Global calls only the authenticated BSS proxy, supports bounded cancellation/cache behavior, and handles no data/stale/error without synthetic substitutions.

tasks.title: T018: operator Global controls and provenance ledger
tasks.source_task: Add Global-mode control, layer ledger, attribution, freshness, caveat, and intelligence-gap UI for TST-007.
tasks.acceptance: The authenticated operator surface distinguishes unavailable, empty, stale, and error states. Every displayed cell/layer gives source class, attribution, freshness, and caveat. No public cover surface receives Nacre-Moiré branding.

tasks.title: T019: integrated regression and migration proof
tasks.source_task: Run TST-001–TST-008 plus existing local viewport/repository regressions and scoped secret scan. Record exact results.
scope: scoped verification only; minimal corrective edits are allowed only when a focused suite proves a defect in this feature lane
tasks.acceptance: Record every command and pass/fail count. A missing approved disposable PostGIS receipt or a failed non-environmental required check blocks the task; do not mask it by weakening an assertion, fallback data, or skipped test.

tasks.title: T020: USGS terms review and controlled enablement receipt
tasks.source_task: Obtain documented USGS terms/attribution review, configure USGS only, execute TST-009, and keep GDACS/NASA EONET disabled.
scope: server-side source configuration only after explicit approval
tasks.acceptance: This card is intentionally blocked until an explicit human/provider-terms approval exists. It must not create credentials, enable a schedule, or perform a live call before that approval is recorded.

tasks.title: T021: Graphify refresh and evidence closeout
tasks.source_task: Refresh Graphify, inspect scoped diff, update package implementation status, and append verified evidence to the daily log.
verification: graphify query for the implemented global path
tasks.acceptance: The task records actual implementation/test evidence and the correct source state. It must state that T020 remains disabled/blocked if no explicit provider approval exists; it must not claim live-source enablement from fixture evidence.
